title: A checkpoint counts every Check press: answer wrong, then retype (or pick the other option, or redraw) and press again, and the question scores right — Reading shows '200%', and a run whose every first answer was wrong passes and pays 60 XP · 15 gold · +5 HP
detail: #/japanese/checkpoints/cp-H on the dense account (mac). (1) For each of the 12 Reading questions: type a wrong reading + Enter (✗ Wrong), then the right reading + Enter, then Enter again; answer Writing/Listening wrong once. Result card: 'Reading 200% ✓ Pass' (stored R clamped to 1), and each question left three 'Next ›' buttons. (2) Second run: every question's FIRST answer wrong (typed 'zzq'; reversed strokes; the wrong one of the two minimal-pair options), then the right one on the same question: result 'Passed. Reading 100% · Writing 100% · Listening 100%', checkpoints['cp-H'] = {scores R1 W1 L1, passAt, paidAt}, one ledger entry {kind:'checkpoint', first:true, award {xp:60, gold:15, hp:5}}, governor +60 XP +15 gold. Expected: one answer per question, as the review session enforces since 9 Nov ('ONE answer per question', jarun.js:494-497): the first verdict counts and the controls lock. Invariant 116 says a checkpoint pays at 80% in every skill; the score it reads is not the learner's.
rootCause: js/modules/japanese.js:731-736 — the checkpoint's KOS.jaRun.mount callback has no once-guard: it does answered++ and right++ and appends a new 'Next ›' on every call. KOS.jaRun.mount (js/modules/jarun.js:117-130, kana-read 132-138, minimal-pair 196-203, kana-write 154-162) leaves the input, Check button, pad and options live after finish(), so each press calls done(res) again. scores[s] = right / keys.length (japanese.js:721) then exceeds 1; KOS.ja.recordCheckpoint clamps to 1 and pays (js/core/ja.js:327-345). Pre-dates Phase 1 (same code at 4c3fc33:japanese.js:622 and f479433b:657); not in November's list.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/ja-mind/checkpoint-result-mac-mine-R200pct.png; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/ja-mind/checkpoint-result-mac-mine-inflated-pass.png; scripts /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/ja-mind/cp-inflate.js and /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/ja-mind/cp-inflate2.js (eval output: log of 26 questions 'Wrong … then Correct', rec {scores:{R:1,W:1,L:1}, passAt, paidAt}, dxp 60, dgold 15)
fix: Give the checkpoint the session's once-guard: a local `done` flag per question that returns on a second call, disables [data-ui~='ja.check'] and the options, and appends one Next. Better, make KOS.jaRun.mount itself lock the exercise after its first finish() (except the near→Retry path) so every caller (session, checkpoint, kana page) is safe. Add a smoke check that presses Check twice in a checkpoint and on the kana page.

title: Kana page: pressing Check or Enter again on one answer records it again — each press is another FSRS review of the same facet, another review-log row, another '+1 XP' and another 'Next ›' (5 presses: reps 5, 5 log rows, +5 XP, set '5 of 20')
detail: #/japanese/kana (Mixed) on the dense account after H1 and H2 were started. Read card: type the right reading of さ and press Enter 5 times. Before: facets['k:さ|R'] = {due today, isNew}. After: reps 5 (one answer), 5 review-log rows for ja:k:さ|R, KOS.ja.paidToday() +5, governor XP +5, the set bar '5 of 20', five 'Next ›' buttons. Second repro (し, Check button clicked 3 times): reps 0→3, paid +3, bar 8 of 20. The review session fixed exactly this on 9 Nov ('40 presses made 40 reviews', jarun.js:494-497) but the kana page's two drills never got the guard. Pay is bounded by the 30-a-day cap, but the schedule (reps) and the review log — the FSRS optimiser's input, invariant 111 — are corrupted, and one answer is paid several times (invariant 116: +1 XP a facet answered).
rootCause: js/modules/japanese.js:477-480 (nextWrite) and 496-505 (nextRead) — the mount callbacks call J().record(ex.key, res), push a result and kanaSync(false) on every call; KOS.jaRun.mount leaves Check/Enter live after finish() (js/modules/jarun.js:117-130, 132-138, 154-162), so each press is a new record(). Pre-dates Phase 1 (f479433b has the same callbacks).
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/ja-mind/kana-mac-mine-5enter.png; script /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/ja-mind/kana-multi.js (eval: before {due,isNew}, after reps 5, paidTodayDelta 5, xpDelta 5, reviewLogRowsAdded 5, nextButtons 5); second eval on し: repsBefore 0, repsAfter 3, paidDelta 3
fix: One answer per question in the kana drills: an `answered` flag in each callback (as jarun.js:494-497) that ignores a second call and disables the card's Check; or lock the exercise inside KOS.jaRun.mount after its first non-near finish() (fixes JM-40 too). Extend smoke83/smoke140 with a double Enter on the kana page asserting one review-log row and +1 XP.

title: A checkpoint in progress is lost without asking when left by Back, the rail or any link: only its ✕ asks 'Leave the checkpoint?' (1D ja-mind#3), the page registers no KOS.view.guard
detail: #/japanese/checkpoints/cp-H, answer some Reading questions, then KOS.show('home') (as a rail tap): the address moves to #/home at once, no dialog, the answers are gone. Second repro on cp-K: one answer, then history.back(): lands on the previous page, no dialog. The ✕ in the run head does ask (answered && !finished). Invariant 166: a real navigation 'first asks when the page says leaving would lose unsaved work (KOS.view.guard)' — the checkpoint says it through its own ✕ only.
rootCause: js/modules/japanese.js:709-714 — leave() is wired to the ✕ button only; checkpointRun never calls KOS.view.guard (js/core/redraw.js:244; the only caller in the app is governor-ui.js:752), so KOS.show/Back navigate freely.
evidence: eval: KOS.show('home') mid-cp-H → {hash:'#/home', dialog:[]}; history.back() mid-cp-K → {hash:'#/japanese/checkpoints/cp-H', dialogs:0}; js/modules/japanese.js:709
fix: In checkpointRun: KOS.view.guard(function () { return answered && !finished ? { title: 'Leave the checkpoint?', body: 'Your answers so far will not be saved or scored.' } : null; }); keep the ✕ going through KOS.show so it asks once, through the same guard.
